title: Yume Monogatari: The Living Dragon (HKAFF)
synopsis: Celebrating the enduring spirit of legendary action star Yasuaki Kurata, this anthology weaves three stories of resilience and dreams. A veteran stunt performer confronts his lifelong dreams in one final audition; a timid office worker discovers her inner strength through surreal encounters with an action star; and an 80-year-old man mysteriously awakens in 1973 Hong Kong on an impossible historic mission. Featuring a special appearance by Sammo Hung, this stirring tribute honours dreamers of all ages.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 80 歲日本動作巨星、武道家倉田保昭縱橫影壇60年，三位門生坂本浩一、 下村勇二和谷垣健治分導三段短篇，以「夢」貫穿時代，連結日港，向動作電影傳奇致敬。開章年老動作演員為試鏡苦練，戲裏戲外為新世代示範永不言退精神；新一代武打女星武田梨奈夢會蒙眼倉田保昭，致敬《精武英雄》與李連杰經典對決，後設視覺直抒李小龍如水無形人生哲理；穿越1973年清水灣片廠，洪金寶特別演出反璞歸真。「傳承」太虛泛，竭盡全力，就是實踐骨氣和反抗精神的最佳動作。

director: Koichi Sakamoto, Yuji Shimomura,  Kenji Tanigaki
